headline.text: Five customers have confirmed containers on MV Ocean Star's delayed voyage VG-1042 (SGSIN to NLRTM): Kaimon Electronics 90, Halden Retail 80, Petra Chemicals 45, Lumio Home 30 and Verdant Foods 22. Northgate Auto's 50 containers were rolled to VG-1107, and Brightline Apparel's 20 were cancelled.

interpretation.text: I read 'Ocean Star's delay' as the current voyage VG-1042. It is Delayed by 55 h, with a revised ETA of 2026-10-27T01:00 UTC. 'On board' means bookings still on VG-1042 with a confirmed status.

confirmed_facts.text: Kaimon Electronics has 90 containers (30 + 60). The bookings are BK-50007 (30) and BK-50002 (60), both Confirmed.
Halden Retail has 80 containers (40 + 25 + 15). The bookings are BK-50001 (40), BK-50004 (25) and BK-50009 (15), all Confirmed.
Petra Chemicals has 45 containers on booking BK-50006, which is Confirmed.
Lumio Home has 30 containers (12 + 18). The bookings are BK-50010 (12) and BK-50005 (18), both Confirmed.
Verdant Foods has 22 containers on booking BK-50003, which is Confirmed.
All the confirmed bookings have a promised delivery date of 2026-10-28. The revised ETA at Rotterdam is 2026-10-27 01:00 UTC.

inferences.text: The 28 Oct promised dates are probably at risk. Only about one day of margin remains after the ETA, and unloading and onward delivery are still needed.
inferences.based_on: The revised ETA is a projection, compared with the promised delivery date.

exclusions.text: Northgate Auto (BK-50008, 50 containers) is excluded from the on-board count. The booking was rolled to VG-1107 (status 'Rolled to VG-1107'), so the customer is affected but is not on board VG-1042.
Brightline Apparel (BK-50011, 20 containers) is excluded because the booking is Cancelled.

data_gaps.text: messages/extra was not loaded, so any messages about these bookings or the delay cause may be missing. I did not look at the delay's causes.

recommended_checks.text: Confirm with Northgate Auto that the roll to VG-1107 (NLRTM to DEHAM, ETA 2026-10-31) is intended. It is a different leg from the one the other bookings are on.

not_checked: Incidents and causes of the 55 h delay
